title: Philly Breakfast Food Tour
blurb:
Taste the heart of Philadelphia with a family-friendly breakfast food tour within steps of many Center City hotels. In only 75 minutes, you'll get a mix of iconic Philly breakfast items with some trendy flavors while soaking in the vibrant atmosphere of one of the city’s top culinary destinations. 

Perfect for families with kids of all ages, cruise passengers, and travelers checking out of hotels, this eating adventure has constant motion strolling through the Reading Terminal Market's colorful aisles. All while indulging in a coffee smoothie, a savory breakfast roll-up, a retro dish with Millennial taste, a sweet dessert from a beloved bakery, and more!

- 75-min guided breakfast tasting experience all within the Reading Terminal Market
- Sample five delicious breakfast items, including local specialties
- Easy walking level completely indoors - great for strollers and wheelchairs
- Ideal for families with kids, food lovers, cruise passengers, and first-time visitors
